{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace SemVerSolver

inductive Version where
  | core (major minor patch : Nat)
  | pre (major minor patch : Nat) (ids : List (Option Nat))
  | build (major minor patch : Nat) (ids : List (Option Nat)) (build : List (Option Nat))

inductive ConstraintOp where
  | eq
  | gt
  | ge
  | lt
  | le

def precedence (v : Version) : List (Option Nat) :=
  match v with
  | Version.core m n p => [some m, some n, some p, some 1]
  | Version.pre m n p ids => [some m, some n, some p, some 0, some (ids.length)]
  | Version.build m n p ids _ => [some m, some n, some p, some 0, some (ids.length)]

def comparePrecedence (a b : Version) : Bool :=
  let pa := precedence a
  let pb := precedence b
  let len := max pa.length pb.length
  let rec loop (i : Nat) : Bool :=
    if i < len then
      let va := if i < pa.length then pa.get! i else none
      let vb := if i < pb.length then pb.get! i else none
      match va, vb with
      | none, none => loop (i + 1)
      | none, some _ => false
      | some _, none => true
      | some x, some y =>
        if x < y then true
        else if x > y then false
        else loop (i + 1)
    else
      false
  loop 0

def satisfiesConstraint (v : Version) (op : ConstraintOp) (target : Version) : Bool :=
  let a := comparePrecedence v target
  let b := comparePrecedence target v
  match op with
  | ConstraintOp.eq => a && b
  | ConstraintOp.gt => a && !b
  | ConstraintOp.ge => a || b
  | ConstraintOp.lt => b && !a
  | ConstraintOp.le => a || b

def isPrerelease (v : Version) : Bool :=
  match v with
  | Version.core _ _ _ => false
  | Version.pre _ _ _ _ => true
  | Version.build _ _ _ _ _ => true

def solve (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) : List Version :=
  let filtered := available.filter (fun v =>
    (if includePrerelease then true else !isPrerelease v) &&
    constraints.all (fun c => satisfiesConstraint v c.1 c.2)
  )
  let deduped := filtered.toSet.toList
  let sorted := deduped.sort (fun a b =>
    let cmp := comparePrecedence a b
    if cmp then true
    else if comparePrecedence b a then false
    else true
  )
  sorted

def validInput (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) : Prop :=
  True

def validSuccess (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) : Prop :=
  validInput available constraints includePrerelease ∧
  (solve available constraints includePrerelease).Nonempty

def validError (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) : Prop :=
  validInput available constraints includePrerelease ∧
  (solve available constraints includePrerelease).isEmpty

theorem thm_O1 (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) :
  validInput available constraints includePrerelease →
  ∃ (result : List Version), result = solve available constraints includePrerelease := by sorry

theorem thm_O2 (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) :
  validInput available constraints includePrerelease →
  ∀ (v : Version), v ∈ solve available constraints includePrerelease →
    v ∈ available ∧
    constraints.all (fun c => satisfiesConstraint v c.1 c.2) ∧
    (includePrerelease ∨ !isPrerelease v) := by sorry

theorem thm_O3 (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) :
  validInput available constraints includePrerelease →
  (solve available constraints includePrerelease).Nodup := by sorry

theorem thm_O4 (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) :
  validInput available constraints includePrerelease →
  let result := solve available constraints includePrerelease
  ∀ (i : Nat), i + 1 < result.length →
    let a := result.get! i
    let b := result.get! (i + 1)
    comparePrecedence a b ∨ comparePrecedence b a := by sorry

theorem thm_O5 (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) :
  validInput available constraints includePrerelease →
  let result := solve available constraints includePrerelease
  ∀ (i : Nat), i + 1 < result.length →
    let a := result.get! i
    let b := result.get! (i + 1)
    (comparePrecedence a b ∧ comparePrecedence b a) →
      a = b := by sorry

theorem thm_O6 (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) :
  validInput available constraints includePrerelease →
  let result := solve available constraints includePrerelease
  result.Nonempty →
    let selected := result.getLast! 
    ∀ (v : Version), v ∈ result →
      comparePrecedence selected v ∨ comparePrecedence v selected := by sorry

theorem thm_O7 (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) :
  validInput available constraints includePrerelease →
  let result := solve available constraints includePrerelease
  result.Nonempty →
    let selected := result.getLast!
    ∀ (v : Version), v ∈ result →
      (comparePrecedence selected v ∧ comparePrecedence v selected) →
        selected = v := by sorry

theorem thm_O8 (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool) :
  validInput available constraints includePrerelease →
  (solve available constraints includePrerelease).isEmpty →
    (solve available constraints includePrerelease).isEmpty := by sorry

theorem thm_I1 (a b : Version) :
  comparePrecedence a b ∨ comparePrecedence b a ∨ (a = b) := by sorry

theorem thm_I2 (v : Version) (op : ConstraintOp) (target : Version) :
  satisfiesConstraint v op target →
    match op with
    | ConstraintOp.eq => comparePrecedence v target ∧ comparePrecedence target v
    | ConstraintOp.gt => comparePrecedence v target ∧ !comparePrecedence target v
    | ConstraintOp.ge => comparePrecedence v target ∨ comparePrecedence target v
    | ConstraintOp.lt => comparePrecedence target v ∧ !comparePrecedence v target
    | ConstraintOp.le => comparePrecedence v target ∨ comparePrecedence target v := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (available : List Version) (constraints : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease : Bool),
    validSuccess available constraints includePrerelease ∧
  ∃ (available2 : List Version) (constraints2 : List (ConstraintOp × Version)) (includePrerelease2 : Bool),
    validError available2 constraints2 includePrerelease2 := by sorry

end SemVerSolver",
